recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is for FHIR-17595. Handle the later display typo, binding-strength change, and broader claiminformationcategory expansion through their own Jira/UTG reconciliation paths.
issue_request: FHIR-17595 was a Published/Persuasive STU3 Financial Management change request to add the claim information category concepts named in Jira as externalCause and patientReasonForVisit to the example claim.information.category value set.
initial_application: The request was applied in commit afb5ec66f6, which added the concepts as lower-case FHIR codes externalcause and patientreasonforvisit to the then-core source/claim/codesystem-claim-informationcategory.xml. Commit 5c0494aacf later removed UTG-maintained terminology content from core, so the current core source correctly delegates concept membership to THO.
additional_context: The current source/claim/valueset-claim-informationcategory.xml is in build scope via the active Claim resource and composes from all codes in http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/claiminformationcategory. The local hl7.terminology.r5#5.3.0 package contains externalcause and patientreasonforvisit. Later issues FHIR-33244 and FHIR-42820 concern the misspelled External Caause display, FHIR-50916 concerns binding strength and a separate THO content exercise, and UP-691 is an unresolved draft broader THO code-system proposal; these do not change the FHIR-17595 concept-presence decision.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. Reintroducing or editing a core CodeSystem copy would be inappropriate because THO is now the authoritative home for the concept definitions, and the active core ValueSet already includes those THO concepts.
